message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build pull request

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - dev

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: burrunan/gradle-cache-action@v3

      - name: Build
        env:
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_githubPackagesUsername: ${{ env.GITHUB_ACTOR }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_githubPackagesPassword: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: ./gradlew build --no-daemon
",
  "rationale": "The workflow already caches Gradle, so dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is contraindicated because an equivalent cache exists, and there is no completed-run history to set a safe custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The supported optimization is P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: cancel superseded in-progress runs for the same workflow/branch-or-PR. Adding a concurrency group keyed by workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress partitions cancellation by branch/PR (distinct branches/PRs never cancel each other), preserves run identity and audit records, removes no build/test step, and requires no new permissions, secrets, or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
